m.Torowisko na ulicy 28 Czerwca 1956 r. (n: The track on 28 June 1956 (in the section from Krzyżowa to Hetmanska – a total of about 700 metres) will be fully upgraded. In recent years, only point repairs have been carried out in this place. However, in view of the state of the infrastructure, a major reconstruction is necessary. At the same time, underground infrastructure, including water and sewerage, will be renovated and rebuilt.
m.W trakcie realizacji wymienione będą tor: Tracks, tracksides and traction networks will be listed during implementation. Special acoustic mats will also be installed, which will affect the track's mutement. The Kosińskiego and Pamiątkowa stops will gain the form of an anti-collar, which will facilitate the use of them for the elderly and for the disabled, including patients and patients in the nearby orthopaedic and Rehabilitation Hospital. They will be equipped with passenger information boards, benches, garbage bins, and the space in their immediate surroundings will be arranged. There will also be more green.

m.– Poznań konsekwentnie inwestuje w tabor: – Poznań invests consistently in rolling stock and at the same time takes care of the good condition of the tracks. Over the last 10 years, PLN 2.5 billion has been allocated for this. About a billion went to purchase new trams and buses, while nearly 1.5 billion went to repair the tracks, traction and construction of new tram routes. Thanks to these investments, our residents are currently moving one of the most modern rolling stock in Poland, after safer and quieter tracks – says Bartosz Derech, deputy president of Poznań. – On 28 June 1956, not only the track with the sub-tower will be listed, but also the traction network, the stop infrastructure and systems related to control of crossovers. It is also important to coordinate the renovation of the track with the modernisation of waterworks and sewerage. This will avoid redeploying the street in the future. Thanks to the reconstruction, which will start on 14 November, the network's unfailing operation and safer, quieter and more comfortable journeys will be ensured. Along with the construction of the tram route to Ratajczak street, the crossing of the tram from Dębca and Wildy to the Centre will be more efficient and faster – added the deputy president.
